mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_organization ORDER BY create_time ASC
SELECT organization_id AS organizationId, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sys_organization_user GROUP BY organization_id
SELECT organization_id AS organizationId, COUNT(*) AS value FROM customer WHERE in_shared_pool = 0 GROUP BY organization_id
SELECT organization_id AS organizationId, COUNT(*) AS value FROM clue WHERE in_shared_pool = 0 AND (transition_type IS NULL OR transition_type != 'CUSTOMER') GROUP BY organization_id
SELECT organization_id AS organizationId, COUNT(*) AS value FROM opportunity GROUP BY organization_id
SELECT organization_id AS organizationId, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sales_order GROUP BY organization_id
SELECT organization_id AS organizationId, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS value FROM contract WHERE void_reason IS NULL OR void_reason = '' GROUP BY organization_id
SELECT organization_id AS organizationId, COALESCE(SUM(record_amount), 0) AS value FROM contract_payment_record GROUP BY organization_id
SELECT ou.organization_id AS organizationId, MAX(l.create_time) AS value FROM sys_login_log l JOIN sys_organization_user ou ON l.operator = ou.user_id GROUP BY ou.organization_id

SELECT ou.organization_id AS organizationId, l.create_time AS createTime FROM sys_login_log l JOIN sys_organization_user ou ON l.operator = ou.user_id WHERE l.create_time >= #{sinceMillis} GROUP BY ou.organization_id, l.create_time

SELECT organizationId, login_city AS value FROM ( SELECT ou.organization_id AS organizationId, l.login_city, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ou.organization_id ORDER BY l.create_time DESC, l.id DESC) AS rn FROM sys_login_log l JOIN sys_organization_user ou ON l.operator = ou.user_id WHERE l.login_city IS NOT NULL AND l.login_city != '' ) x WHERE rn = 1

SELECT organizationId, login_city AS value FROM ( SELECT ou.organization_id AS organizationId, l.login_city, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ou.organization_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM sys_login_log l JOIN sys_organization_user ou ON l.operator = ou.user_id WHERE l.create_time >= #{sinceMillis} AND l.login_city IS NOT NULL AND l.login_city != '' GROUP BY ou.organization_id, l.login_city ) x WHERE rn = 1
